reason: The README clearly describes a chat image-attachment bridge and view_image tool that forwards images to configurable vision-language model endpoints and returns textual analysis.

summaries.zh: 在聊天中接收粘贴或拖拽的图片，并通过可配置的视觉模型端点为纯文本模型提供图像理解能力。
summaries.en: Accepts pasted or dropped chat images and uses a configurable vision-model endpoint to provide image understanding for text-only models.

capabilities: Accepts pasted or dropped image attachments in chat
Persists image attachments and bridge files locally
Sends images and user questions to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision model endpoint
Provides a view_image tool that returns textual image analysis
